text:
Palladium Price in 2026
Among 9 monthly observations available for 2026, the LBMA palladium price fell 30.9% between 2026-01-30 ($1,820) and 2026-09-25 ($1,257). The highest sampled price was $1,820 in January and the lowest was $1,220 in June. The mean of these observations was $1,458. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
